message.content:
Sure! Here are a few options that will let you bake a chocolate cake right at home:

| Machine | Why it’s great for a chocolate cake | Typical size / capacity |
|---------|-------------------------------------|--------------------------|
| **Counter‑top convection oven** | Even heat distribution and quick pre‑heat make it perfect for a uniform rise and golden crust. | 1–2‑quart (about 1–2 cups of batter) |
| **Toaster oven** | Compact, easy to use, and many models have a “bake” setting that works well for small cakes. | 1‑quart (about 1 cup of batter) |
| **Cake maker / cake machine** (e.g., “Cake Maker” brand, “Cake Machine” from KitchenAid) | Designed specifically for baking cakes; you pour batter into the pan and the machine does the rest. | 1‑quart (about 1 cup of batter) |
| **Microwave with baking function** | Great for quick, single‑serving cakes if you’re short on time. | 1‑quart (about 1 cup of batter) |
| **Air fryer** | Uses rapid air circulation for a crisp top and moist interior. | 1‑quart (about 1 cup of batter) |

All of these machines can handle a standard 1‑quart chocolate cake batter (roughly 1 cup of batter). If you’re looking for something that can bake a larger cake, a full‑size oven or a dedicated cake pan in a conventional oven would be the way to go. Happy baking!
